title: corbularia graellsii
intro: Corbularia graellsii, commonly known as Corbularia, is a species of lichenized fungus in the family Pyrenulaceae. It is a type of fungus that grows on trees and rocks, and is often used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Corbularia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. Corbularia contains bioactive constituents such as usnic acid, which exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, and are used to treat various conditions including wounds, dermatitis, and infections.
